verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs show in-person card acceptance through physical Solo and Go readers, via the Cloud API, Reader SDKs or Payment Switch. They also document Tap to Pay for contactless payments on a phone, so the contactless part of the story is covered. However, no evidence explicitly mentions chip (EMV) insertion or Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV support, explicit Apple Pay / Google Pay acceptance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
